name: Floor Scrubber Vacuum Motor
definition: A motor-driven vacuum fan or turbine that creates the airflow and pressure differential for recovered solution; voltage, input power, fan stages, airflow/vacuum curve, cooling, discharge, sealing and machine controls must match.
includedScope: Vacuum fan and motor assemblies for scrubber-dryers
Single-, two- and three-stage recovery architectures
Electrical, aerodynamic, mounting, sealing and machine-fit checks
excludedScope: Motor-only comparisons without fan, airflow and recovery-system scope
primaryApplications: OEM service replacement and system qualification
headline: Voltage and wattage are only the start; fan stage, airflow curve, sealing and controls complete the fit.
description: This profile maps scrubber vacuum fan assemblies and machine recovery systems using official parts, service and machine evidence.
metaDescription: Floor scrubber vacuum motor voltage, power, stages, airflow, vacuum, cooling, sealing and exact machine compatibility checks.
disclaimer: Physical resemblance, matching wattage, matching voltage, a generic family name or a seller claim does not establish compatibility. Verify the current manufacturer part number and revision, machine model and serial scope, mechanical, electrical and fluid interfaces, rated operating envelope, protection requirements and approved service documentation.
